row: Earl E. Bakken Center for Spirituality & Healing

The University of Minnesota Earl E. Bakken Center for Spirituality & Healing is celebrating 30 years of advancing the health and wellbeing of individuals, organizations, and communities.

We provide interprofessional education, conduct research, advance integrative models of care, and deliver innovative community engagement programs locally, nationally and internationally. Our faculty are leaders from diverse academic backgrounds, and are passionate experts in their fields.
